_comment: What the Android app ships under www/assets/: the world map, trimmed to the z8 the map actually renders (scripts/trim-pmtiles.mjs), plus the web-sized stock world and editor seed in their deep-cleaned editions (-clean on the release: the Scenario Workshop's border cleanup at 1.5 km run to the end over them, so a save of that world in the app has nothing left to repair; the stock world keeps the country codes it has always carried here as owners) and the cities seed. Every file is a release asset of the map-data GitHub Release, pinned by size and sha256; mobile/scripts/stage-map-assets.mjs downloads and verifies them into mobile/map-cache/ and stage-www.mjs copies them into the bundle. The 55 MB desktop-only files are never shipped.
